proposals.name: llm_relative_strength_trend_efficiency_inter_3d169412
proposals.economic_logic: High relative strength backed by strong trend efficiency indicates sustainable institutional buying rather than erratic retail speculation. Multiplying these factors filters out high-volatility, low-quality breakouts in China industry ETFs.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: ETFs with concurrently high relative strength and high trend efficiency will outperform the cross-section over the medium term due to continued capital inflows into strong thematic trends.
failure_modes: Sharp macroeconomic policy pivots causing sudden, violent factor rotations across industries.
Extended trending environments reaching exhaustion, leading to a severe mean-reversion shock.

proposals.name: llm_short_term_reversal_under_low_risk_quali_7377e79b
proposals.economic_logic: Short-term oversold conditions (captured by reversal_5) provide a high-conviction entry signal when the industry's underlying risk quality is poor, suggesting the sell-off was overextended relative to structural risk.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: Industry ETFs experiencing short-term price drops paired with low structural risk quality exhibit rapid mean-reversion over short horizons as liquidity demands normalize.
failure_modes: A prolonged downward trend where the short-term drop is driven by structural deterioration rather than transient liquidity pressures.

proposals.name: llm_volume_confirmed_momentum_fbb95c98
proposals.economic_logic: Price momentum without volume support is prone to false breakouts. Combining medium-term momentum with volume confirmation ensures that the trend is backed by broad market participation and rising liquidity.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: ETFs showing strong 20-day momentum accompanied by robust volume confirmation will exhibit higher trend persistence than those with weak volume backing.
failure_modes: Volume spikes occurring at the absolute peak of a thematic blow-off top, leading to immediate losses.

proposals.name: llm_volatility_adjusted_macro_trend_e01fcbca
proposals.economic_logic: A strong monthly trend is more predictive of future excess returns if it is achieved with lower realized volatility, representing a stable and steady accumulator phase by longer-term institutional funds.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: ETFs with high long-term trend scores and low short-term realized volatility generate superior risk-adjusted alpha over the next 20 trading days.
failure_modes: Low volatility regimes that abruptly end due to unexpected regulatory announcements or global macro shocks.

proposals.name: llm_downside_risk_mitigated_setup_218d41a1
proposals.economic_logic: An optimal trading setup should be discounted by the historical presence of downside tail risk. Penalizing the technical setup score by the downside volatility isolates clean breakout patterns from asymmetric risk structures.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: High setup scores that are not undermined by heavy historical downside volatility provide cleaner, more reliable tactical entry points.
failure_modes: Environments where high downside volatility is actually a precursor to an explosive, volatile bottoming pattern breakout.
